description: This Java source file defines the NoteListViewModel class, which is part of the Android app and manages data for a note list UI. It uses Android Architecture Components like LiveData and ViewModel to fetch and transform note categories and counts from the NotesRepository, providing observable data for the UI.

classes.name: NoteListViewModel
classes.description: An Android ViewModel that provides categories and counts of notes for the note list UI, leveraging LiveData transformations to produce observable data streams for the view.

methods.name: NoteListViewModel
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the repository instance.

methods.name: getAdapterCategories
methods.description: Returns LiveData containing a list of NavigationItems representing note categories and counts, formatted for adapter consumption.
